title: Hide chart sits on the report's filter row, right of the filters
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  1. You are signed in as an Admin (the Admin role has every permission, including Reports).
  2. You are in one location (workplace).
  3. You use a desktop browser at 100% zoom on a screen at least 1024 pixels wide (any ordinary laptop or desktop monitor).
custom_steps:
1. Click Reports in the top bar and click Sales in the left menu.
  2. Look at the row that holds the report's filters, its ⋯ (more actions) menu if it has one, and the Hide chart control.
  3. Compare the gaps between neighbouring controls on that row.
  4. Repeat on Advisor Analysis, Technician Efficiency and Technician Utilization.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • The Hide chart control is on the same horizontal row as the filters and the ⋯ menu, immediately to their right.
  • The gaps between each pair of neighbouring controls on that row look the same.
  • The control is never on a row of its own above the chart.
  • Write down any report where the ⋯ menu is missing or sits on the other side of the filters, or where a gap is visibly wider.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-490; story SV-9583 (Story 11, Chart on the Report Page); Dashboard v1 PRD, Confluence 788430850 v42, read 7 Oct 2026, Story 11.
